title: 5 PC game deals worth buying this week
metaDescription: Five well-reviewed PC games with worthwhile prices in LootRadar's July 29 snapshot, including the evidence and buying caveat behind each pick.
socialDescription: Five current PC game offers that pair strong player reviews with prices worth a closer look.
socialSummary: Disco Elysium, Red Dead Redemption 2, Slay the Spire, and two more current standouts.
intro: There are hundreds of discounted games in the latest LootRadar snapshot. Most do not need your attention. These five rose to the top because the current price is backed by a large body of positive player reviews, not just an oversized percentage badge.
This is a starting point, not a five-game shopping list. Pick the game that suits what you actually want to play, confirm the edition and activation details, and leave the rest without remorse.

picks.title: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
picks.imageAlt: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut cover art
picks.copy: At 92% positive across roughly 57,100 Steam reviews, Disco Elysium has unusually deep evidence behind its reputation. The 78% price cut makes this a strong entry point if you want a dialogue-heavy detective RPG and do not mind trading conventional combat for choices, failure, and a lot of reading.

picks.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
picks.copy: A 92% positive rating from more than 307,000 Steam reviews gives this open-world western one of the strongest confidence signals in the snapshot. The pace is deliberate and the install is substantial, so buy it for the long campaign and richly observed world, not because you need something quick for the weekend.

picks.title: Mortal Kombat 11 Ultimate
picks.copy: The Ultimate edition combines a low single-digit price with an 88% positive rating from about 87,500 reviews. It is the most straightforward value here for fighting-game players, but check that the included roster and online population match what you expect before choosing it over a newer entry.

picks.title: Slay the Spire
picks.copy: Slay the Spire is the critical-consensus pick: 97% positive from roughly 76,400 reviews. Runs are compact, but learning how cards, relics, and enemy patterns fit together can last for hundreds of hours. At 75% off, it is easy to recommend to anyone curious about deck-building games.

picks.title: Hogwarts Legacy
picks.copy: The current 85% cut is supported by a 91% positive Steam rating from about 142,500 reviews. This is the cinematic open-world option in the group. Before buying, confirm that you are comfortable using the Epic Games Store and that your PC meets the game's storage and performance needs.
